# Glosso

noun · art and literary movement

> Glosso is a literary movement centered on the perfectionistic, recursive and prosodic articulation of experience. It treats voice, rhythm, language and form as instruments of experiential expression, subordinating stylistic identity and established literary conventions to the experience being communicated.

Based in: Miami

Current mascot: Bizzare Frog with an odd ribbon shaped tongue.
